title: The Word Belonging
short_teaser: Belonging is more than being present in a place.
story: Belonging is more than being present in a place. It includes being recognized, accepted, and able to participate without hiding essential parts of oneself. A useful word can reveal why inclusion and attendance are not identical. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
